name: DS Cluster S03: Forward Fill (ffill vs ffill_day)
description: Tests: ffill() for indefinite carry-forward, ffill_day() for day-boundary carry. Both on daily and intraday sparse sources.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER S03: ffill vs ffill_day
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# === SPARSE SOURCE: CPI (monthly observation dates) ===
cpi_src = common_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.CPI)()

# ffill: carries value forward INDEFINITELY until next observation
cpi_forever = ffill(cpi_src.result)

# ffill_day: carries value forward only within the SAME calendar day
# On daily bars, ffill_day is equivalent to no-fill (1 bar per day)
# On intraday bars, ffill_day fills within a session but resets at midnight
cpi_day_only = ffill_day(cpi_src.result)

# === SPARSE SOURCE: NFP calendar (boolean, ~12x/year) ===
nfp_cal = economic_calendar(source=CalendarSource.FRED, release_id=50)()

# ffill: once True, stays True until explicitly overwritten
# BAD for event detection — turns a pulse into a step
nfp_ffill = ffill(nfp_cal.is_released)

# ffill_day: True on all bars of event day, resets to null next day
# CORRECT for intraday event detection
nfp_day = ffill_day(nfp_cal.is_released)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title="CPI: ffill (indefinite) vs ffill_day (day boundary)",
    category="Fill Patterns",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="ffill", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="ffill_day", color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(cpi_forever, cpi_day_only))

cards(
    category="Fill Patterns",
    layout=CardLayout(title="NFP: ffill vs ffill_day", cells=[
        ColumnSpec(title="ffill (stays True)", card_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat),
        ColumnSpec(title="ffill_day (day only)", card_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat)
    ])
)(nfp_ffill, nfp_day)
